ios-feedback|Feedback.summary: Plenix feedback on iOS is built from system views with the Plenix look: a section message is a rounded box in its tone’s soft fill with the tone’s symbol, a semibold title, the text, up to two bordered buttons and a dismiss button; an error state is the system ContentUnavailableView with the Plenix tone on its symbol, its title and description in DM Sans, and one action; a retry shows the wait and the attempt under the message with Retry. VoiceOver reads the title and the text; a danger message is posted as an announcement when it appears, and a retry’s countdown is never read every second.

variants.name: Retry

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.about: The section message’s rounded box in the tone’s soft fill, with a hairline in the tone’s border color.

anatomy.name: Symbol
anatomy.about: The tone’s SF Symbol, in the tone’s content color (section message) or solid color (error state).

anatomy.name: Title
anatomy.about: A few words in DM Sans, semibold, that name the message or the state.

anatomy.name: Text
anatomy.about: One or two sentences in DM Sans at the secondary role.

anatomy.name: Actions
anatomy.about: One or two bordered buttons (Retry, Upgrade); the error state has one.

anatomy.name: Dismiss
anatomy.about: An xmark button at the end, with a 44 pt target, when the message may be put away.

anatomy.name: Retry status
anatomy.about: The wait (Retrying in 4 sec) and the attempt (Attempt 2 of 3) in the data font under the text.

swiftui: /// The Plenix section message on iOS: the tone’s soft fill, its symbol, a title, the text, actions and a dismiss button.
if let onDismiss { Button(action: onDismiss) { Image(systemName: "xmark") }.accessibilityLabel("Dismiss") }
/// The Plenix error state: ContentUnavailableView with the tone on its symbol and one action.
Label("The assets could not load", systemImage: "exclamationmark.triangle").foregroundStyle(Plenix.Colors.feedbackDangerSolid)
appkit: // AppKit: PlenixTokens.swift is iOS-only (UIColor); a macOS build of the tokens is needed for these names.
